intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Crafted strength beneath timeless style
features.text: Our engineered wood frame is built to last — giving you solid, dependable support with a refined, elegant look that suits any space.

features.title: Box storage that keeps things simple
features.text: Lift-up underbed storage helps you keep your space organised and stress-free — perfect for tucking away extras without any visual clutter. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Comfort that invites you in
features.text: The cushioned headboard gives you a soft place to rest, whether you're sitting up with a good book or enjoying a slow start to your day.

features.title: A finish that feels as good as it looks
features.text: The textured matte wood finish adds a subtle, natural warmth to your room — tactile, modern, and soothing to the eye.

features.title: Storage where it matters most
features.text: With built-in headboard storage and an additional ledge, you’ll always have space for your night-time essentials — stylish, functional, and right where you need them.

name: Upmods Lattice King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
